campaign: same-binary 2x2 factorial: gated EKF baro-velocity aid x age-gated terminal flare
evidence_level: L2 (real firmware + 6DOF plant + sensor models, SIL only)
scenario: 30 m settled, 60 s outage 43-103 s (no recovery before landing), 1 m/s2 wind, 6 dirs x 10 seeds, aid/flare runtime toggles
verdict: Flare-only is nearly ineffective in the same binary (3.35 -> 3.17 m/s), contradicting the earlier cross-binary 1.48 m/s flare result. aid-only is best (1.10 m/s); aid+flare is worse than aid-only (1.34 m/s) and does not reduce drift. The earlier 1.48 m/s flare result was confounded by binary/layout differences and must be marked historical. Do not use the current flare; use aid-only if opting in.
caveats: The flare's age>20 s and altitude<8 m trigger leaves too little time in this 60 s trajectory; it overrides the EKF v_d with a baro slope and undoes part of the aid benefit.
All arms settle; drift remains a safety-vs-footprint trade for the aid.
All numbers are scalar-Eigen SIL L2, not real aircraft.
